nodes.label: ML-DSA-87 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 204 Category 5 post-quantum digital signature algorithm parameter set based on the hardness of Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) and Module Short Integer Solution (M-SIS) lattice problems.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Multi-Logical Device (MLD) Architecture
nodes.description: CXL memory device architecture enabling a physical memory component to present up to 16 virtual logical devices (LDs) to multiple host root complexes with distinct security and memory capacity bounds.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Morphological Disambiguation Engine
nodes.description: Contextual morphological disambiguation subsystem in CAMeL Tools selecting canonical morphological analyses and feature bundles for MSA and dialectal Arabic tokens.

nodes.label: W3C RDF-Star and SPARQL-Star Conceptual Model and Syntax
nodes.description: Extension to the W3C RDF standard enabling nested triples and statement-level metadata annotations (quoted triples) without standard RDF reification overhead.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Parallel Breadth-First Search (BFS) Vector-Matrix Kernel
nodes.description: Algebraic graph traversal primitive executing parallel frontier expansion via sparse vector-matrix multiplication (vM * A) over the Boolean semiring.
